title: Tinkering Teacup Tetra
statement: A pinprick-sized fish with a translucent porcelain body, painted with a delicate blue floral pattern, that spends its days rearranging a tiny sunken tea set on the sand and nudging each cup into a more perfect spot with a soft *clink*. When it is satisfied, it glows a warm amber, and a slow stream of bubbles rises from the spout of the teapot like steam, through lamplit water the color of weak jasmine tea.
